name: ervalume
title: Ervalume restaurant
description: A finished bilingual sample site for a fictional neighbourhood restaurant that cooks over wood: home, menu with prices, about, table booking and contact pages in English and Brazilian Portuguese, with a designed theme, self-hosted fonts and its own photography. Apply it to a new site to see what Viglet Shio renders.

pt-BR.title: Restaurante Ervalume
pt-BR.description: Um site de exemplo pronto e bilíngue para um restaurante de bairro fictício que cozinha na lenha: páginas de início, cardápio com preços, sobre, reserva de mesa e contato em português e inglês, com tema desenhado, fontes próprias e fotografia original. Aplique em um site novo para ver o que o Viglet Shio desenha.

assets.alt: An empty dining room set for the evening, a row of wooden tables under brass lamps, pots of rosemary and basil on the window sill and a wood oven glowing at the back.
A whole grilled fish with charred skin on a dark plate, beside a small bowl of green herb sauce, half a lime and roasted cassava.
A brick wood-fired grill with a whole fish, red peppers and courgettes over glowing embers, herbs hanging from a rail above and cast iron pans stacked beside it.
Portrait from the chest up of a chef in a linen apron in her kitchen, copper pans hanging behind her, smiling.
A market stall with a wooden crate of coriander and basil, bundles of chives, a basket of red chillies, cassava roots and limes.
A roasted banana with cinnamon sticks, a scoop of coconut ice cream and dark caramel on a pale ceramic plate, a spoon beside it.
The front of a small restaurant on a cobbled street, whitewashed walls, open green wooden doors, potted herbs and two small tables with chairs on the pavement.
A round table for four in front of a tall window, set with a linen cloth, plates, folded napkins, glasses, a carafe of water and a small jar of fresh herbs.
